insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: If higher room category is chosen, rateable proportion of associated medical expenses (excluding pharmacy, diagnostics, implants, consumables) is borne by insured.

icu.note: Policy does not explicitly state a separate ICU room limit; general room rent cap of Single Private Room applies.

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies on all admissible claims under B1, B2, B3, B7, B8, B12, B15, B16. Not applicable on Road Ambulance (B9) and sub-limited surgical procedures (Cataract, Joint Replacement).

sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹40k–₹1L per eye (zone/SI dependent); Joint Replacement: ₹1.6L–₹5L per person (zone/SI dependent). Sub-limits include pre/post-hosp expenses for these procedures.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage from first policy inception.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most listed conditions (cataract, hernia, calculus, etc.) have 24-month wait; joint replacement surgeries have 36-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl 18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% of base SI added per claim-free year; reduced by 10% after a claim year. Max 100% of base SI.

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days before admission (B2). AYUSH benefit covers 90 days pre-hosp.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge (B3). AYUSH benefit covers 90 days post-hosp.

day_care.note: B7 covers day care treatment due to disease/illness/injury at hospital or day care centre.

domiciliary.note: B16 Home Care Treatment covers dialysis, chemotherapy, and pandemic care at home up to 10% of SI. Not a broad domiciliary cover.

ayush.note: B8 covers AYUSH inpatient and day care treatment with pre/post-hosp of 90 days each. Assessed per AYUSH insurance guidelines.

organ_donor.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention organ donor expense cover.

ambulance.note: B9 covers road ambulance up to ₹5,000 per hospitalisation. Mandatory 20% co-pay not applicable on this benefit.

modern_treatments.note: Policy wording does not explicitly mention modern/robotic surgery treatments as a named benefit.

consumables.note: B12 Consumables Benefit covers specified consumables (Annexure-1 List 1) used during hospitalisation. Personal comfort items, external durable devices excluded.

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly states coverage is only for medical treatment taken within India; payments in Indian Rupees within India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years of coverage, no claim/policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document.

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; credits for PED, specific waiting periods, moratorium transferred.

notable_exclusions.display: Dental treatment, sleep apnoea, stem cell therapy, growth hormone therapy, alcoholic pancreatitis, STDs, external congenital anomalies, hearing aids/spectacles

optional_riders.display: None explicitly listed as optional riders in the policy wording
optional_riders.note: Policy includes several inbuilt value-added services: home physiotherapy (B4), home nursing (B5), compassionate care (B6), wellness/teleconsultation (B17), high-end diagnostics (B15).
